schema.transition_clock: time_s is transition end in that episode; action held over [time_s-dt_s,time_s]
schema.PANN: Causal observer recovery at 0.002/0.2/0.5 s, each foot, metres; saved normalized obs[-12:] times0.001.
schema.phase_channels: obs[80:89] in original fixed nine-phase order
schema.value: Saved behavior value/next_value; no network recomputation. bootstrap_value is zero on physical terminated, next_value on external truncated.
schema.reward_components: Original recorded increments; action_change absent in W38 logs is reported missing, not inferred from reward.
schema.behavior_version: Recorded at sampling when available, otherwise saved update boundaries (new update applies after its last sampled transition).
schema.evaluation_W38_missing: Original fixed-policy W38 evaluation saved transition scalars but no rollout values/features; unavailable fields remain null.
